hypothesis: Diagnostic entities at the reported version, followed by native typed code relationships, can recover evidence absent from traceback-only paths.

method.entity_terms: Same primary-diagnostic identifier extraction as the lexical control; no titles, PR labels or repository-specific vocabulary.
method.entity_resolution: Native CBM exact-name lookup at the reported version; zero, one and multiple matches stay distinct.
method.compiler_control: Qualified file:line:column error locations resolved against the reported Git tree, without requiring a CBM symbol.
method.symbol_incident: One native Cypher query for incident typed edges of diagnostic entities and the last resolved frame in each traceback.
method.file_imports: One native Cypher query for outgoing IMPORTS edges from seed and compiler-coordinate files.
method.history: The bounded first-parent file-change and exact PR-landing semantics from R002.
method.cost_bound: 500 edge rows per relationship query with one sentinel row for truncation; duplicate file histories share a scope while retaining additional code witnesses.

independent_first_parent_diff_checks.scope: Every evidence item in each code arm's first 100 candidates

additional_reference.inspection: The actual diff adds special-method handling so placeholder calls and conversions raise a missing-dependency error. The PR adds tests for these operations. This improves diagnostics; it does not install or repair the user's missing dependency.

false_unique_match.name: _C
false_unique_match.code_meaning: TypeVar bound to PretrainedConfig in vllm/model_executor/models/vision.py
false_unique_match.implication: A unique static name match is not enough to establish the runtime entity.

capability_findings: The pinned CBM query_graph implements format=json and returns structured columns/rows, but its advertised input schema omits that parameter. This was checked against the exact binary and its source commit; no C changes are included.
The graph preserves r.strategy and r.confidence where present. Empty properties remain unknown, not fabricated high-confidence evidence.

CBM contains an IMPORTS edge from the native compiler's attention.cpp location to cpu_types.hpp. The Git source of that header conditionally includes architecture-specific headers; the one-hop experiment does not reach those files.
limitations: Known references are incomplete relevance anchors, not exhaustive recall or demonstrated fixes. No real agent, GPU or whole-repository runtime reproduction was performed.
The exact-name method is retained as a candidate lane, not an automatic entity binder. Candidate kind and surrounding diagnostic context matter.
Snapshot projections omit and report dangling edges; zero affected observed endpoints does not prove complete indexing.
All results are from the registered vLLM development cases. Held-out retrieval and cross-repository effectiveness remain untested.

next.hypothesis: A bounded, directional file-import chain from explicit compiler coordinates can add evidence beyond one-hop file history without the unrelated exact-name and broad incident expansions.
acceptance: Generate seeds only from explicit log coordinates, with no reference-file or PR-number inputs.
Execute the path traversal in CBM, retain each typed hop and its source version, and verify useful paths against native Git source.
Treat conditional includes as static possibilities unless build configuration is also evidenced.
Compare candidate budgets and latency as well as additional useful evidence; do not replace the successful narrow lanes.
Freeze a meaningful retrieval checkpoint before querying held-out outcomes.
next.cost_followup: The existing GitHub commit-reference index excludes pull and pull-git landing fields. A later downstream landing index may avoid repeated payload scans, but must preserve frozen selection and exact source pointers.
